name: lfs_micro_yoy
notes: LFS-Micro composition-adjusted wage growth (% Y/Y), published directly by the Bank of Canada as a Y/Y series. No derivation applied; this is a passthrough copy from data/raw/lfs_micro.csv with an explicit processed/ meta record. BoC publishes this series as INDINF_LFSMICRO_M on the Valet API. Conceptually: the LFS microdata re-weights wage growth to hold composition constant (industry/occupation mix), giving a cleaner underlying wage-pressure signal than the headline LFS average hourly wages.
